summary: Signs of progress in US-Iran talks add to support from foreign buying and cheaper crude, but a stretched rally and a busy results week ahead keep the next session finely balanced.

detail.leaders: Oil-sensitive sectors and large caps, if US-Iran talks keep crude in check

detail.tone: Little has changed since the 0800 note; the main addition is mixed but hopeful news on US-Iran talks. Next sessions: Sunday's Diwali Muhurat hour, then Monday Nov 9; Tuesday Nov 10 is a holiday.
